essence: One who desires attainment should have the appropriate formula spoken to them.
By uttering this formula, one may obtain that attainment.
The invoked power is indeed one who bears a manifest form.
The formula consists of the stated mantra elements together with the beloved powers.
One should serve the deity who grants boons and fearlessness and who goes upon a swan.
